nodes.label: RULE 0 — Follow the user's explicit instructions (blocking)
nodes.rationale: User instructions are blocking, not suggestions: reuse named existing code before reinventing, act on 'look at X / use Y / do Z first' immediately, never silently substitute an approach, disagree openly rather than disobey quietly. Ignoring instructions wastes the user's time, tokens and money.

nodes.label: Versioning guardrail — every code change ships with a version bump
nodes.rationale: Real funds, real chain: bumping versionCode + versionName in app/build.gradle on every code change keeps every committed state distinct, reversible and trackable. One logical change = one version = one commit = one push, in order. Docs/config-only commits need no bump.

nodes.label: .githooks/pre-commit version-bump hook
nodes.rationale: Installed once via sh .githooks/install.sh; blocks a code change with no version bump. Must not be bypassed with --no-verify.
